export const invoiceTotal = (lines: readonly { qty: number; price: number; kind: string }[], vip: boolean): number => {
  let total = 0;
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (line.qty > 0) {
      if (line.kind === "service") {
        if (vip) {
          total += line.qty * line.price * 0.9;
        } else if (line.price > 100) {
          total += line.qty * line.price * 0.95;
        } else {
          total += line.qty * line.price;
        }
      } else if (line.kind === "product" && line.price > 0) {
        total += line.qty * line.price;
      }
    }
  }
  return total;
};

export const createInvoice = (customer: string, street: string, city: string, zip: string, country: string, notes: string): string =>
  [customer, street, city, zip, country, notes].join("\n");

export const invoiceLabel = (total: number): string => {
  if (total > 1000) return "large";
  return "small";
};

export const invoiceCode = (customer: string, year: number): string => {
  const prefix = customer.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase();
  return `${prefix}-${String(year)}`;
};

export const createReceipt = (order: { customer: string; total: number }): string => {
  const header = `Receipt for ${order.customer}`;
  return `${header}: ${String(order.total)}`;
};
